newsitem.title: UK: UK's FTSE 100 soars 100 pts in pre-Budget rally.
newsitem.headline: UK's FTSE 100 soars 100 pts in pre-Budget rally.

text.p: The UK's FTSE 100 index surged more than 100 points on Tuesday in a pre-Budget rally driven by soaring index futures and a firm early performance on Wall Street.
The UK index was up 101.6 points or 2.2 percent at 4,706.2 by 1442 GMT, led by sharp gains in index heavyweights such as drug group Glaxo Wellcome and banking groups Lloyds TSB and HSBC Holdings.
The September index futures contract was up 149 points at 4,755.
